fields.acceptance: A new testscript cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/plan-milestone-interview-waiting.txtar runs a non-autonomous milestone plan run inside a fake rex (REX_BLOCK set) with fake claude: the run driver's Rex output carries a blocked OSC 7501 report naming the milestone interview before the agent asks anything, and a feature plan run's and an autonomous milestone run's carry none at launch; a new unit test TestProgramStatusMilestoneInterview in internal/api/run_status_test.go checks the launch report's encoding (blocked, naming the milestone interview) and that a feature plan run and an autonomous run get none; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/plan-milestone-interview-waiting and go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestProgramStatusMilestoneInterview pass
fields.statement: When a milestone plan run driven inside Rex (REX_BLOCK set) launches its interview session, the run driver reports its own Rex status as blocked, waiting on the owner (OSC 7501), naming the milestone interview and its tab, at launch rather than at the agent's first question, so Rex notifies the owner that the interview waits on them; a daemon-started run's driver runs outside Rex and writes no such report, its notification being inbox-milestone-interview's daemon notification; other plan runs and autonomous runs report as before
